newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Oil to buy 900,000 bbl May Iraq crude.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Oil to buy 900,000 bbl May Iraq crude.

text.p: Nippon Oil Co Ltd said on Wednesday it would buy 900,000 barrels of end-May loading Iraqi crude oil, having received approval from the United Nations in mid-April.
The refiner has agreed with Iraq to buy Basrah Light crude at a discount of 55 cents to the official selling price of Saudi Arabia's Arab Light crude, a Nippon Oil spokesman said.

A Very Large Crude Carrier (VLCC), which will carry the Basrah Light together with about 900,000 barrels of another type of crude that has yet to be decided, is scheduled to reach Japan by end-June, the spokesman said.
It has not been decided which refinery the crude will be shipped to, the spokesman added.

Under the U.N. oil-for-food accord, Iraq is allowed to sell $2 billion worth of crude over a six-month period, in order to buy food and medicine for civilians suffering from sanctions imposed on Baghdad after it invaded Kuwait in August 1990.
Nippon Oil already imported 1.1 million barrels Iraq's Basrah Light crude in February, under the oil-for-food deal, through trading house Mitsubishi Corp.
